messages.author: 0504f38dd61c3312
messages.subject: change position of facet strip
parts:
I have a one column facet_grid. The text strip is on the right side of
the plots. Is it possible to change the strip to the top of the plots
instead?

I have pretty long names for each of the plots and the right-sided
strip text won't fit into the height of the plots. It would fit nicely
if the strip is on top instead of the right side.

messages.author: 13ff1921a4b26560
messages.subject: Re: change position of facet strip
parts:
Could you just switch to facet_wrap?

qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + facet_grid(cyl ~ .)
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + facet_wrap(~cyl, ncol = 1)

-Allan (R 2.13.1, ggplot2 0.8.9)
